title: Claude Code: Extend Claude with skills
summary: A skill is a SKILL.md of instructions Claude loads when relevant or that you run as /name; frontmatter sets name, description, invocation, allowed-tools, context: fork and paths, and !`command` lines inject live output. Custom slash commands are now skills. Cloud sessions load skills enabled on the claude.ai account, not ~/.claude/skills.
ideas: A /intent skill can print an intent's state with !`...` but it costs a Claude turn and draws nothing.
avenCEO's harness rules could ship as a skill that every thread loads.

took.idea: Skills carry instructions, the mod carries the view
